# web-part-shell API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Actual SPFx web-part integration, persisted editable titles and inherited host presentation.

## getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata

Create fresh SPFx metadata marking only the plain title as searchable.
Compose the result with the web part's metadata; titleHTML remains ordinary data.
Does not import Property Pane runtime or mutate consumer metadata.

### Imports

```ts
import { getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/web-part-shell';
```

### Use when

- An SPFx web part persists shell title properties and must mark the plain title as searchable metadata.

### Avoid when

- Keep titleHTML as ordinary data; do not mark rich serialized HTML as searchable plain text.

### Examples

```ts
import { IWebPartShellProperties, getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { BaseClientSideWebPart, IWebPartPropertiesMetadata } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
export class ExampleWebPart extends BaseClientSideWebPart<IWebPartShellProperties> {
  public render(): void { this.domElement.textContent = this.properties.title; }
  protected get propertiesMetadata(): IWebPartPropertiesMetadata {
    return { ...getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata() };
  }
}
```

### Signatures

```ts
(): IWebPartPropertiesMetadata
```

#### Returns

A new map and title descriptor on every call.

## WebPartShell

Compose SPFx and Fluent providers for an actual web part and its stable content.
Same-instance rerenders, title Read/Edit, visibility/placement, Card size and non-subtle appearance
updates retain children; a new instanceId resets them. Subtle/Card transitions can remount children.
The existing provider waits for ServiceScope readiness and isolates runtime state.
Theme precedence is explicit override, ancestor Fluent, live host, then light fallback.
Uses the web part ownerDocument and inherited Griffel renderer; hosts must supply a
renderer for that document. Subtle (default) adds no Card. Filled, filled-alternative
and outline render a native vertical Card with focusMode off; size defaults to medium. Title placement
defaults to outside; inside places the complete header into Card. Subtle ignores placement and size.
Section adds no outer inset; application auto padding
is medium below a 640px container inline size and large from 640px.
Shell owns outer padding and header/body spacing; native Card owns its inner spacing.
Title and header actions are vertically centered within their wrapping row.
Hiding the title removes the complete header and its gap without evaluating action callbacks.
Header placement changes can remount the header. Appearance/size/titlePosition are optional React
options; no additional persisted properties are required.
Native div attributes/events, className, caller style and ref reach the shell root.
No normalized/default title property is written at mount.

### Use when (2)

- A real SPFx web-part instance needs matching providers, host spacing and persisted editable title integration.

### Avoid when (2)

- Use the matching direct SPFx provider for hosts that are not web parts.

### Examples (2)

#### Basic usage

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { IWebPartShellProperties, WebPartShell } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Button } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import * as ReactDom from 'react-dom';
import { BaseClientSideWebPart } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
interface Properties extends IWebPartShellProperties { listId: string; }
export class ExampleWebPart extends BaseClientSideWebPart<Properties> {
  public render(): void {
    ReactDom.render(<WebPartShell instance={this} appearance="filled" size="small" titlePosition="inside"
      action={<Button onClick={() => this.render()}>Refresh</Button>}>
      <p>Workspace content</p>
    </WebPartShell>, this.domElement);
  }
  protected onDispose(): void { ReactDom.unmountComponentAtNode(this.domElement); }
}
```

#### First web part with metadata and native Property Pane

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import * as ReactDom from 'react-dom';
import { BaseClientSideWebPart, type IWebPartPropertiesMetadata } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
import { PropertyPaneToggle, type IPropertyPaneConfiguration } from '@microsoft/sp-property-pane';
import {
  WebPartShell,
  getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata,
  useSPFxProperties,
  useSPFxUserInfo,
  type IWebPartShellProperties,
} from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface IExampleWebPartProperties extends IWebPartShellProperties {
  description: string;
}

function Content(): React.ReactElement {
  const { displayName } = useSPFxUserInfo();
  const { properties } = useSPFxProperties<IExampleWebPartProperties>();
  return <p>Hello {displayName}! {properties?.description}</p>;
}

export default class ExampleWebPart extends BaseClientSideWebPart<IExampleWebPartProperties> {
  public render(): void {
    ReactDom.render(
      <WebPartShell instance={this} appearance="outline" size="medium" titlePosition="outside">
        <Content />
      </WebPartShell>,
      this.domElement
    );
  }

  protected get propertiesMetadata(): IWebPartPropertiesMetadata {
    return {
      ...getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata(),
      description: { isSearchablePlainText: true },
    };
  }

  protected getPropertyPaneConfiguration(): IPropertyPaneConfiguration {
    return { pages: [{ groups: [{ groupName: 'Title', groupFields: [
      PropertyPaneToggle('showTitle', { label: 'Show title', checked: this.properties.showTitle ?? true }),
    ] }] }] };
  }

  protected onDispose(): void {
    ReactDom.unmountComponentAtNode(this.domElement);
  }
}
```

#### Customize the header action and restore a hidden title

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import * as ReactDom from 'react-dom';
import { BaseClientSideWebPart } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
import { WebPartShell, useSPFxProperties, type IWebPartShellProperties } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
function HideTitle() {
  const { setProperties } = useSPFxProperties<IWebPartShellProperties>();
  return <button type="button" onClick={() => setProperties({ showTitle: false })}>Hide title</button>;
}
function ShowTitle() {
  const { setProperties } = useSPFxProperties<IWebPartShellProperties>();
  return <button type="button" onClick={() => setProperties({ showTitle: true })}>Show title</button>;
}
export default class HeaderActionWebPart extends BaseClientSideWebPart<IWebPartShellProperties> {
  private readonly actionRef = React.createRef<HTMLDivElement>();
  public render(): void {
    ReactDom.render(<WebPartShell instance={this} action={{ ref: this.actionRef,
      children: (Component, props) => <Component {...props}><HideTitle /></Component>,
    }}><ShowTitle /><p>Body state belongs to the application.</p></WebPartShell>, this.domElement);
  }
  protected onDispose(): void { ReactDom.unmountComponentAtNode(this.domElement); }
}
```

#### Configure the actual web part Shell

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Field, Select } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { useSPFxProperties, useSPFxDisplayMode, type IWebPartShellProperties, type WebPartShellProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface DemoRegions {
  controls?: React.ReactNode;
  commands?: React.ReactNode;
  status?: React.ReactNode;
  diagnostics?: React.ReactNode;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}
function standalone(regions: DemoRegions): React.ReactElement {
  return <div>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</div>;
}
interface DemoShellPort {
  presentation: Required<Pick<WebPartShellProps<IWebPartShellProperties>, 'appearance' | 'size' | 'titlePosition' | 'padding'>>;
  updatePresentation(patch: Partial<DemoShellPort['presentation']>): void;
}
interface DemoProps {
  render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement;
  resetRevision?: number;
  shell?: DemoShellPort;
}

// The host supplies its existing Shell and initialized SPFx provider, never a nested Shell.
export function Demo({ render = standalone, resetRevision = 0, shell }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  return shell === undefined
    ? <p>This scenario requires the actual WebPartShell host, its presentation port and initialized SPFx provider.</p>
    : <ShellContent render={render} resetRevision={resetRevision} shell={shell} />;
}
function ShellContent({ render, resetRevision, shell }: {
  render: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement;
  resetRevision: number;
  shell: DemoShellPort;
}): React.ReactElement {
  const { properties, setProperties } = useSPFxProperties<IWebPartShellProperties>();
  const { isEdit } = useSPFxDisplayMode();
  const showButton = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null); // React 17 ref interoperability requires null.
  const revision = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    // Mount and native Read/Edit updates only observe the revision. A later
    // revision is an explicit reset; no persisted properties are written on mount.
    if (revision.current === resetRevision) return;
    revision.current = resetRevision;
    shell.updatePresentation({ appearance: 'subtle', size: 'medium', titlePosition: 'outside', padding: 'auto' });
    if (isEdit) setProperties({ title: 'SPFx React Toolkit', titleHTML: undefined, showTitle: true });
  }, [resetRevision, shell, isEdit, setProperties]);
  const showTitle = properties?.showTitle ?? true;
  const previousShowTitle = React.useRef(showTitle);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const becameHidden = previousShowTitle.current && !showTitle;
    previousShowTitle.current = showTitle;
    if (becameHidden) showButton.current?.focus();
  }, [showTitle]);
  return render({
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Appearance"><Select aria-label="Appearance" value={shell.presentation.appearance}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ appearance: event.target.value === 'filled' ? 'filled' : event.target.value === 'filled-alternative' ? 'filled-alternative' : event.target.value === 'outline' ? 'outline' : 'subtle' })}>
        <option value="subtle">Subtle</option><option value="filled">Filled</option><option value="filled-alternative">Filled alternative</option><option value="outline">Outline</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Card size"><Select aria-label="Card size" value={shell.presentation.size}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ size: event.target.value === 'small' ? 'small' : event.target.value === 'large' ? 'large' : 'medium' })}>
        <option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option><option value="large">Large</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Title position"><Select aria-label="Title position" value={shell.presentation.titlePosition}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ titlePosition: event.target.value === 'inside' ? 'inside' : 'outside' })}>
        <option value="outside">Outside</option><option value="inside">Inside</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Spacing"><Select aria-label="Spacing" value={shell.presentation.padding}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ padding: event.target.value === 'none' ? 'none' : event.target.value === 'small' ? 'small' : event.target.value === 'medium' ? 'medium' : event.target.value === 'large' ? 'large' : 'auto' })}>
        <option value="auto">Auto</option><option value="none">None</option><option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option><option value="large">Large</option>
      </Select></Field>
    </>,
    commands: <>
      <Button onClick={() => setProperties({ showTitle: false })}>Hide title</Button>
      <Button ref={showButton} onClick={() => setProperties({ showTitle: true })}>Show title</Button>
      <Button disabled={!isEdit} onClick={() => { if (isEdit) setProperties({ title: 'Project documents', titleHTML: undefined }); }}>Plain title</Button>
      <Button disabled={!isEdit} onClick={() => { if (isEdit) setProperties({ title: 'Project documents', titleHTML: '<h2><strong>Project</strong> documents</h2>' }); }}>Formatted title</Button>
      <Button disabled={!isEdit} onClick={() => { if (isEdit) setProperties({ title: '', titleHTML: '' }); }}>Empty title</Button>
    </>,
    status: <div role="status" aria-live="polite"><p>Mode: {isEdit ? 'Edit' : 'Read'}</p>
      <p>Use the actual host title and header action. Presentation presets are explicit; Reset restores this source baseline and restores the title only in Edit.</p></div>,
    diagnostics: <output>{JSON.stringify({ title: properties?.title, titleHTML: properties?.titleHTML, showTitle: properties?.showTitle, ...shell.presentation })}</output>,
  });
}
export const demo = {
  host: 'webPart', kind: 'snapshot', contentPlacement: 'configuration', hostAdapter: 'webPartShell',
  observe: 'Configure the actual outer Shell. Its title and action are outside this scenario; native Read/Edit comes from SharePoint. Reset writes the source title only in Edit.',
};
```

#### Retain content through Shell presentation changes

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Field, Input, Select } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { useSPFxDisplayMode, type IWebPartShellProperties, type WebPartShellProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

interface DemoRegions {
  controls?: React.ReactNode;
  commands?: React.ReactNode;
  status?: React.ReactNode;
  diagnostics?: React.ReactNode;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
}
function standalone(regions: DemoRegions): React.ReactElement {
  return <div>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</div>;
}
interface DemoShellPort {
  presentation: Required<Pick<WebPartShellProps<IWebPartShellProperties>, 'appearance' | 'size' | 'titlePosition' | 'padding'>>;
  updatePresentation(patch: Partial<DemoShellPort['presentation']>): void;
}
interface DemoProps {
  render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement;
  resetRevision?: number;
  shell?: DemoShellPort;
}

// The host supplies its existing Shell and initialized SPFx provider, never a nested Shell.
export function Demo({ render = standalone, resetRevision = 0, shell }: DemoProps = {}): React.ReactElement {
  return shell === undefined
    ? <p>This scenario requires the actual WebPartShell host, its presentation port and initialized SPFx provider.</p>
    : <ShellContent render={render} resetRevision={resetRevision} shell={shell} />;
}
function ShellContent({ render, resetRevision, shell }: {
  render: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement;
  resetRevision: number;
  shell: DemoShellPort;
}): React.ReactElement {
  const { isEdit } = useSPFxDisplayMode();
  const [note, setNote] = React.useState('Intranet project review');
  const [count, setCount] = React.useState(0);
  const revision = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (revision.current === resetRevision) return;
    revision.current = resetRevision;
    setNote('Intranet project review');
    setCount(0);
    shell.updatePresentation({ appearance: 'outline', size: 'medium', titlePosition: 'outside' });
  }, [resetRevision, shell]);
  const cardReady = shell.presentation.appearance !== 'subtle';
  return render({
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Card appearance"><Select aria-label="Card appearance" disabled={!cardReady}
        value={shell.presentation.appearance === 'subtle' ? 'outline' : shell.presentation.appearance}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ appearance: event.target.value === 'filled' ? 'filled' : event.target.value === 'filled-alternative' ? 'filled-alternative' : 'outline' })}>
        <option value="filled">Filled</option><option value="filled-alternative">Filled alternative</option><option value="outline">Outline</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Card size"><Select aria-label="Card size" disabled={!cardReady} value={shell.presentation.size}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ size: event.target.value === 'small' ? 'small' : event.target.value === 'large' ? 'large' : 'medium' })}>
        <option value="small">Small</option><option value="medium">Medium</option><option value="large">Large</option>
      </Select></Field>
      <Field label="Title position"><Select aria-label="Title position" disabled={!cardReady} value={shell.presentation.titlePosition}
        onChange={event => shell.updatePresentation({ titlePosition: event.target.value === 'inside' ? 'inside' : 'outside' })}>
        <option value="outside">Outside</option><option value="inside">Inside</option>
      </Select></Field>
    </>,
    commands: <Button onClick={() => shell.updatePresentation({ appearance: 'outline' })}>Use Card baseline</Button>,
    status: <div role="status" aria-live="polite"><p>Mode: {isEdit ? 'Edit' : 'Read'} · Child counter: {count}</p>
      <p>Choose Use Card baseline first, then edit the note and counter. Card variants, size, title position and host-owned title visibility preserve content. Reset preserves the persisted title.</p></div>,
    children: <>
      <Input aria-label="Project note" value={note} onChange={(_event, data) => setNote(data.value)} />
      <Button onClick={() => setCount(current => current + 1)}>Increment counter</Button>
    </>,
    diagnostics: <output>{JSON.stringify({ note, count, ...shell.presentation })}</output>,
  });
}
export const demo = {
  host: 'webPart', kind: 'snapshot', contentPlacement: 'configuration', hostAdapter: 'webPartShell',
  observe: 'Choose Use Card baseline, edit the note and increment. Card variants, size, title position and host-owned title visibility retain content. Reset preserves all persisted title properties in Read and Edit.',
};
```

## IWebPartShellProperties

Persisted title properties owned by WebPartShell. Extend with application properties.
Do not narrow these keys: the shell publishes ordinary strings and visibility values.

### Imports (3)


### Members

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IWebPartShellProperties.showTitle` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Display the complete title/action header; undefined behaves as true without a property write.<br>False unmounts the header and suppresses action render callbacks. |
| `IWebPartShellProperties.title` | `string` | Required | — | Plain searchable title, kept in sync with rich-title edits. Literal H2 fallback when<br>`titleHTML` is absent; metadata searchability requires `getWebPartShellPropertiesMetadata`. |
| `IWebPartShellProperties.titleHTML` | `string \| undefined` | Optional | — | Authoritative toolkit rich-title HTML; defined empty means an empty title.<br>Saved HTML is normalized to one paragraph or H1-H4 block with supported inline formatting.<br>Input and canonical output are limited to 65,536 UTF-8 bytes; parser nesting is limited<br>to depth 32. Invalid or oversized input falls back to the plain title without a<br>mount-time property rewrite. See the WebPartShell guide's Title authority and HTML<br>protocol section for accepted tags and semantic class markers.<br>Title edits publish normalized safe markup together with the plain title.<br>Colors are stable semantic IDs resolved from the current Fluent theme;<br>UI-language changes never translate author content or rewrite these IDs.<br>When omitted, the plain title property supplies the initial/read title. |

## WebPartShellAppearance

Native Fluent Card appearance, defaulting to `subtle`. Subtle renders no Card;
filled, filled-alternative and outline use a vertical Card with focusMode off.
Card size defaults to medium and can be selected independently.
Card spacing and visual treatment follow the host Fluent theme.

## WebPartShellPadding

Logical Fluent inset: `none`, `small`, `medium` or `large`. `auto` (default) uses none
for section and responsive medium/large application padding around the 640px container breakpoint.

### Imports (5)


## WebPartShellProps

Actual SPFx web-part shell options and native div attributes. Composes the toolkit
SPFx and Fluent providers internally, waiting for ServiceScope readiness. The host
must supply its document's Griffel renderer. No editor engine types are public.
Native SPFx resources select title/editor labels. Instance dictionaries can
override shell naming and editor commands independently. Theme-color identifiers
and author content remain language-independent.
The editor offers 12 theme tones and 10 standard hues from foreground tokens
and fixed theme-derived mixes, without custom HEX colors. Coincident values
are deduplicated while preserving the selected semantic color.
Inline formatting applies to selected text, or to the entire nonempty title
when only a caret is present. Toolbar commands and Ctrl/Cmd+B/I/U preserve
the caret/range and provide individual undo boundaries. Empty-title inline formatting
affects subsequent typing without publishing an empty document.

```ts
import type { WebPartShellProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { WebPartShellProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/web-part-shell';
```

### Examples (6)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { IWebPartShellProperties, WebPartShell } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { Button } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import * as ReactDom from 'react-dom';
import { BaseClientSideWebPart } from '@microsoft/sp-webpart-base';
interface Properties extends IWebPartShellProperties { listId: string; }
export class ExampleWebPart extends BaseClientSideWebPart<Properties> {
  public render(): void {
    ReactDom.render(<WebPartShell instance={this} appearance="filled" size="small" titlePosition="inside"
      action={<Button onClick={() => this.render()}>Refresh</Button>}>
      <p>Workspace content</p>
    </WebPartShell>, this.domElement);
  }
  protected onDispose(): void { ReactDom.unmountComponentAtNode(this.domElement); }
}
```

Card owns inner spacing.<br>When omitted, defaults to subtle renders no Card. |

## WebPartShellSize

Native Fluent Card size: small, medium or large. When omitted, defaults to medium.
Controls the Card's native padding, gap and radius; outer surface padding is independent.
Subtle appearance ignores size because it renders no Card. Size updates preserve
the Card, header/editor and body identity without writing persisted properties.

## WebPartShellStrings

Shell-owned title naming, independent of editor command dictionaries. Native
SPFx resources supply omitted override fields; these labels never alter author
title content or persisted properties. Empty placeholders suppress the hint.
An empty editor label still requires a valid accessible name in Edit.

## WebPartShellSurface

Host surface policy: `auto` detects Teams or a single-web-part app page as `application`;
other hosts use `section`. Both wrappers remain transparent. `section` adds no
automatic inset; `application` enables responsive automatic outer padding.
Card appearance controls the optional visual surface. When omitted, defaults to `auto`.

## WebPartShellTitlePosition

Placement of the complete title/action header relative to a rendered Card.
Defaults to outside. Subtle ignores this option because it has no Card.
Changing placement can remount the header while preserving body state.
